Neither rename touches phonology, etymology or naming, so a mechanical fix should be the whole of it. FOUR FINDINGS WORTH STEALING, all measured. ONE, BSD sed backslash-b IS NOT A WORD BOUNDARY AND FAILS SILENTLY. On this Mac, sed s/backslash-b-X-backslash-b/Y/ matches nothing, exits 0, prints no diagnostic. A 67-site rename would have reported success and moved zero sites, and the suite would have passed because nothing changed. Use the BSD classes open-bracket-open-bracket-colon-less-than-colon and its mirror, and verify a mass rename BY COUNT, never by exit status or a green suite. TWO, grep -c on a type name followed by a brace counts the type DEFINITION as a construction site. That produced three wrong figures here before anyone noticed. THREE, NOTHING IN THE GATE LADDER CHECKS RUSTDOC. Deleting a pub type orphaned an intra-doc link and no gate could see it; main already carries two unresolved links and 43 links-to-private-item warnings. Filed as TOOL-rustdoc-links.
